reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7463, book 97, بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {قُلْ لَوْ كَانَ الْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ الْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْفَدَ كَلِمَاتُ رَبِّي وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مَدَدًا}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ تَكَفَّلَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ جَاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ، لاَ يُخْرِجُهُ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ إِلاَّ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِهِ، وَتَصْدِيقُ كَلِمَتِهِ أَنْ يُدْخِلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ، أَوْ يَرُدَّهُ إِلَى مَسْكَنِهِ بِمَا نَالَ مِنْ أَجْرٍ أَوْ غَنِيمَةٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn Yusuf narrated to us: Malik informed us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A‘raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said, “Allah has guaranteed the one who strives in His cause—nothing took him out except striving in His cause and belief in His words—that He will admit him to Paradise or return him to his home with the reward or booty he gained.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7464, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا دَعَوْتُمُ اللَّهَ فَاعْزِمُوا فِي الدُّعَاءِ، وَلاَ يَقُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ إِنْ شِئْتَ فَأَعْطِنِي، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ مُسْتَكْرِهَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Musaddad narrated to us: Abd al-Warith narrated to us, from Abd al-Aziz, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “When you supplicate to Allah, be resolute in your supplication. None of you should say, ‘If You will, give this to me,’ for no one can compel Allah.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7465, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، أَنَّ حُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ ـ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ ـ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَرَقَهُ وَفَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْلَةً فَقَالَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ أَلاَ تُصَلُّونَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا أَنْفُسُنَا بِيَدِ اللَّهِ، فَإِذَا شَاءَ أَنْ يَبْعَثَنَا بَعَثَنَا، فَانْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ قُلْتُ ذَلِكَ، وَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ إِلَىَّ شَيْئًا، ثُمَّ سَمِعْتُهُ وَهْوَ مُدْبِرٌ يَضْرِبُ فَخِذَهُ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ [quran sura="18" aya_start="54" aya_end="54"]‏{‏وَكَانَ الإِنْسَانُ أَكْثَرَ شَىْءٍ جَدَلاً‏}‏‏"‏
en_text: Abu al-Yaman narrated to us: Shu‘ayb informed us, from al-Zuhri. Ismail narrated to us: My brother Abd al-Hamid narrated to me, from Sulayman, from Muhammad ibn Abi Atiq, from Ibn Shihab, from Ali ibn Husayn, that Husayn ibn Ali informed him, that Ali ibn Abi Talib informed him: The Messenger of Allah came to him and Fatimah, the daughter of the Messenger of Allah, one night and said, “Will you not pray?” Ali said: I replied, “O Messenger of Allah, our souls are in Allah’s hand; when He wills to raise us, He raises us.” The Messenger of Allah turned away and said nothing. Then I heard him as he walked away, striking his thigh and saying, “Man is the most argumentative of things” Quran 18:54.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7466, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِلاَلُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَمَثَلِ خَامَةِ الزَّرْعِ، يَفِيءُ وَرَقُهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَتَتْهَا الرِّيحُ تُكَفِّئُهَا، فَإِذَا سَكَنَتِ اعْتَدَلَتْ، وَكَذَلِكَ الْمُؤْمِنُ يُكَفَّأُ بِالْبَلاَءِ، وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَمَثَلِ الأَرْزَةِ صَمَّاءَ مُعْتَدِلَةً حَتَّى يَقْصِمَهَا اللَّهُ إِذَا شَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Sinan narrated to us: Fulayh narrated to us: Hilal ibn Ali narrated to us, from Ata ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said, “The believer is like a tender crop: the wind bends its leaves whichever way it comes, and when it subsides it straightens. The believer is likewise bent by affliction. The disbeliever is like a firm cedar, standing upright until Allah breaks it whenever He wills.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7467, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهْوَ قَائِمٌ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا بَقَاؤُكُمْ فِيمَا سَلَفَ قَبْلَكُمْ مِنَ الأُمَمِ، كَمَا بَيْنَ صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ إِلَى غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ، أُعْطِيَ أَهْلُ التَّوْرَاةِ التَّوْرَاةَ، فَعَمِلُوا بِهَا حَتَّى انْتَصَفَ النَّهَارُ، ثُمَّ عَجَزُوا، فَأُعْطُوا قِيرَاطًا قِيرَاطًا، ثُمَّ أُعْطِيَ أَهْلُ الإِنْجِيلِ الإِنْجِيلَ، فَعَمِلُوا بِهِ حَتَّى صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ، ثُمَّ عَجَزُوا، فَأُعْطُوا قِيرَاطًا قِيرَاطًا، ثُمَّ أُعْطِيتُمُ الْقُرْآنَ فَعَمِلْتُمْ بِهِ حَتَّى غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ، فَأُعْطِيتُمْ قِيرَاطَيْنِ قِيرَاطَيْنِ، قَالَ أَهْلُ التَّوْرَاةِ رَبَّنَا هَؤُلاَءِ أَقَلُّ عَمَلاً وَأَكْثَرُ أَجْرًا‏.‏ قَالَ هَلْ ظَلَمْتُكُمْ مِنْ أَجْرِكُمْ مِنْ شَىْءٍ قَالُوا لاَ‏.‏ فَقَالَ فَذَلِكَ فَضْلِي أُوتِيهِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Al-Hakam ibn Nafi informed us: Shu‘ayb informed us, from al-Zuhri: Salim ibn Abdullah informed me that Abdullah ibn Umar said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, standing on the pulpit, say, “Your remaining time, compared with the nations before you, is like the time between Asr prayer and sunset. The people of the Torah were given the Torah and acted by it until midday, then became unable, and were given one qirat each. The people of the Gospel were given the Gospel and acted by it until Asr, then became unable, and were given one qirat each. You were given the Quran and acted by it until sunset, and were given two qirats each.” The people of the Torah said, “Our Lord, these people did less work but received more reward.” He said, “Have I withheld any of your reward?” They said, “No.” He said, “That is My favor; I give it to whom I will.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7468, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الْمُسْنَدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ بَايَعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَهْطٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أُبَايِعُكُمْ عَلَى أَنْ لاَ تُشْرِكُوا بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا، وَلاَ تَسْرِقُوا، وَلاَ تَزْنُوا، وَلاَ تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلاَدَكُمْ، وَلاَ تَأْتُوا بِبُهْتَانٍ تَفْتَرُونَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَرْجُلِكُمْ وَلاَ تَعْصُونِي فِي مَعْرُوفٍ، فَمَنْ وَفَى مِنْكُمْ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا فَأُخِذَ بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا فَهْوَ لَهُ كَفَّارَةٌ وَطَهُورٌ، وَمَنْ سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فَذَلِكَ إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنْ شَاءَ عَذَّبَهُ وَإِنْ شَاءَ غَفَرَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah al-Musnadi narrated to us: Hisham narrated to us: Ma‘mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Idris, from Ubadah ibn al-Samit, who said: I pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah among a group of men. He said, “I take your pledge that you will not associate anything with Allah, steal, commit adultery, kill your children, bring a false accusation you fabricate between your hands and feet, or disobey me in what is right. Whoever fulfills this, his reward is with Allah. Whoever commits any of these and is punished for it in this world, that is an expiation and purification for him. Whoever Allah conceals, the matter is up to Allah: if He wills, He will punish him, and if He wills, He will forgive him.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7469, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ سُلَيْمَانَ ـ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ـ كَانَ لَهُ سِتُّونَ امْرَأَةً فَقَالَ لأَطُوفَنَّ اللَّيْلَةَ عَلَى نِسَائِي، فَلْتَحْمِلْنَ كُلُّ امْرَأَةٍ وَلْتَلِدْنَ فَارِسًا يُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، فَطَافَ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ، فَمَا وَلَدَتْ مِنْهُنَّ إِلاَّ امْرَأَةٌ وَلَدَتْ شِقَّ غُلاَمٍ‏.‏ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ كَانَ سُلَيْمَانُ اسْتَثْنَى لَحَمَلَتْ كُلُّ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ، فَوَلَدَتْ فَارِسًا يُقَاتِلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Mu‘alla ibn Asad narrated to us: Wuhayb narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Muhammad, from Abu Hurayrah, that Solomon, the Prophet of Allah, had sixty wives. He said, “Tonight I will go around to my wives; let each conceive and give birth to a horseman who will fight in Allah’s cause.” He went around to them, but none gave birth except one, who bore half a boy. The Prophet of Allah said, “If Solomon had made the exception, every one of them would have conceived and given birth to a horseman who would fight in Allah’s cause.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7470, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَى أَعْرَابِيٍّ يَعُودُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ بَأْسَ عَلَيْكَ طَهُورٌ، إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ الأَعْرَابِيُّ طَهُورٌ، بَلْ هِيَ حُمَّى تَفُورُ عَلَى شَيْخٍ كَبِيرٍ، تُزِيرُهُ الْقُبُورَ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَنَعَمْ إِذًا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad narrated to us: Abd al-Wahhab al-Thaqafi narrated to us: Khalid al-Hadhdha narrated to us, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, that the Messenger of Allah visited a Bedouin who was ill. He said, “There is no harm for you; it is a purification, if Allah wills.” The Bedouin said, “A purification? No, it is a fever boiling over an old man and taking him to the graves.” The Prophet said, “Then so be it.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7471, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ سَلاَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حِينَ نَامُوا عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ، قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَبَضَ أَرْوَاحَكُمْ حِينَ شَاءَ، وَرَدَّهَا حِينَ شَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَضَوْا حَوَائِجَهُمْ وَتَوَضَّئُوا إِلَى أَنْ طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَابْيَضَّتْ فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى‏.‏
en_text: Ibn Salam narrated to us: Hushaim informed us, from Husayn, from Abdullah ibn Abi Qatadah, from his father, concerning when they slept through the prayer. The Prophet said, “Allah took your souls when He willed and returned them when He willed.” They attended to their needs and performed ablution until the sun had risen and become bright, then he stood and prayed.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7472, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، وَالأَعْرَجِ،‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَخِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ اسْتَبَّ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَرَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ الْمُسْلِمُ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُحَمَّدًا عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ فِي قَسَمٍ يُقْسِمُ بِهِ، فَقَالَ الْيَهُودِيُّ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُوسَى عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ، فَرَفَعَ الْمُسْلِمُ يَدَهُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ فَلَطَمَ الْيَهُودِيَّ، فَذَهَبَ الْيَهُودِيُّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِالَّذِي كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ وَأَمْرِ الْمُسْلِمِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُخَيِّرُونِي عَلَى مُوسَى، فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ يَصْعَقُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَأَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ يُفِيقُ، فَإِذَا مُوسَى بَاطِشٌ بِجَانِبِ الْعَرْشِ، فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَكَانَ فِيمَنْ صَعِقَ فَأَفَاقَ قَبْلِي أَوْ كَانَ مِمَّنِ اسْتَثْنَى اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Qaza‘ah narrated to us: Ibrahim narrated to us, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah and al-A‘raj. Ismail narrated to us: My brother narrated to me, from Sulayman, from Muhammad ibn Abi Atiq, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman and Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyab, that Abu Hurayrah said: A Muslim man and a Jewish man exchanged insults. The Muslim swore, “By the One who chose Muhammad above all people,” and the Jew swore, “By the One who chose Moses above all people.” The Muslim raised his hand and slapped the Jew. The Jew went to the Messenger of Allah and told him what had happened between them. The Prophet said, “Do not give me precedence over Moses, for people will be struck unconscious on the Day of Resurrection, and I will be the first to recover. Then I will see Moses holding on to the side of the Throne. I do not know whether he was among those who were struck unconscious and recovered before me, or among those whom Allah exempted.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7473, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ أَبِي عِيسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْمَدِينَةُ يَأْتِيهَا الدَّجَّالُ فَيَجِدُ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ يَحْرُسُونَهَا فَلاَ يَقْرَبُهَا الدَّجَّالُ وَلاَ الطَّاعُونُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Abi Isa informed us: Yazid ibn Harun informed us: Shu‘bah informed us, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “The Dajjal will come to Medina and find angels guarding it, so the Dajjal will not approach it, nor will the plague, if Allah wills.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7474, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ، فَأُرِيدُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ أَخْتَبِيَ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Yaman informed us: Shu‘ayb informed us, from al-Zuhri: Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated to me that Abu Hurayrah said: The Messenger of Allah said, “Every Prophet had a supplication. If Allah wills, I wish to reserve my supplication as intercession for my community on the Day of Resurrection.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7475, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَسَرَةُ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ جَمِيلٍ اللَّخْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَيْنَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ رَأَيْتُنِي عَلَى قَلِيبٍ فَنَزَعْتُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ أَنْزِعَ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا ابْنُ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ فَنَزَعَ ذَنُوبًا أَوْ ذَنُوبَيْنِ وَفِي نَزْعِهِ ضَعْفٌ، وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَهُ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا عُمَرُ فَاسْتَحَالَتْ غَرْبًا، فَلَمْ أَرَ عَبْقَرِيًّا مِنَ النَّاسِ يَفْرِي فَرِيَّهُ، حَتَّى ضَرَبَ النَّاسُ حَوْلَهُ بِعَطَنٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yasrah ibn Safwan ibn Jamil al-Lakhmi narrated to us: Ibrahim ibn Sa‘d narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “While I was sleeping, I saw myself at a well and drew from it as much as Allah willed. Then Ibn Abi Quhafah took the bucket and drew one or two buckets, and there was weakness in his drawing—may Allah forgive him. Then Umar took it, and it became a large bucket. I never saw a masterful person among the people draw as he did, until the people watered their camels and rested them at the watering place.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7476, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ السَّائِلُ ـ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ جَاءَهُ السَّائِلُ ـ أَوْ صَاحِبُ الْحَاجَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ اشْفَعُوا فَلْتُؤْجَرُوا، وَيَقْضِي اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِ رَسُولِهِ مَا شَاءَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Ala narrated to us: Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Burayd, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa, who said: When a petitioner—or a person with a need—came to the Prophet, he would say, “Intercede, and you will be rewarded; Allah will decree whatever He wills through the tongue of His Messenger.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7477, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَقُلْ أَحَدُكُمُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي إِنْ شِئْتَ، ارْحَمْنِي إِنْ شِئْتَ، ارْزُقْنِي إِنْ شِئْتَ، وَلْيَعْزِمْ مَسْأَلَتَهُ، إِنَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَاءُ، لاَ مُكْرِهَ لَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Yahya narrated to us: Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us, from Ma‘mar, from Hammam, who heard Abu Hurayrah narrate from the Prophet, who said, “None of you should say, ‘O Allah, forgive me if You will; have mercy on me if You will; provide for me if You will.’ Let him be firm in asking, for He does whatever He wills and no one can compel Him.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7478, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَفْصٍ، عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ أَنَّهُ تَمَارَى هُوَ وَالْحُرُّ بْنُ قَيْسِ بْنِ حِصْنٍ الْفَزَارِيُّ فِي صَاحِبِ مُوسَى أَهُوَ خَضِرٌ، فَمَرَّ بِهِمَا أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، فَدَعَاهُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ إِنِّي تَمَارَيْتُ أَنَا وَصَاحِبِي هَذَا فِي صَاحِبِ مُوسَى الَّذِي سَأَلَ السَّبِيلَ إِلَى لُقِيِّهِ، هَلْ سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَذْكُرُ شَأْنَهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ بَيْنَا مُوسَى فِي مَلإِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ إِذْ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا أَعْلَمَ مِنْكَ فَقَالَ مُوسَى لاَ‏.‏ فَأُوحِيَ إِلَى مُوسَى بَلَى عَبْدُنَا خَضِرٌ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَ مُوسَى السَّبِيلَ إِلَى لُقِيِّهِ، فَجَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ الْحُوتَ آيَةً وَقِيلَ لَهُ إِذَا فَقَدْتَ الْحُوتَ فَارْجِعْ فَإِنَّكَ سَتَلْقَاهُ‏.‏ فَكَانَ مُوسَى يَتْبَعُ أَثَرَ الْحُوتِ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَقَالَ فَتَى مُوسَى لِمُوسَى أَرَأَيْتَ إِذْ أَوَيْنَا إِلَى الصَّخْرَةِ فَإِنِّي نَسِيتُ الْحُوتَ وَمَا أَنْسَانِيهِ إِلاَّ الشَّيْطَانُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ، قَالَ مُوسَى ذَلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِي، فَارْتَدَّا عَلَى آثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا فَوَجَدَا خَضِرًا، وَكَانَ مِنْ شَأْنِهِمَا مَا قَصَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn Muhammad narrated to us: Abu Hafs, Amr, narrated to us: al-Awza‘i narrated to us: Ibn Shihab narrated to me, from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah ibn Mas‘ud, from Ibn Abbas, who said: He and al-Hurr ibn Qays ibn Hisn al-Fazari disagreed about Moses’ companion, whether he was Khadir. Ubayy ibn Ka‘b al-Ansari passed by them, so Ibn Abbas called him and said, “My companion and I disagree about Moses’ companion, whom he sought a way to meet. Have you heard the Messenger of Allah mention his story?” He said, “Yes. I heard the Messenger of Allah say: While Moses was among an assembly of the Children of Israel, a man came and asked, ‘Do you know anyone more learned than you?’ Moses said, ‘No.’ Allah revealed to Moses, ‘Yes, Our servant Khadir is.’ Moses asked for a way to meet him. Allah made the fish a sign for him and told him, ‘When you lose the fish, turn back, for you will meet him.’ Moses followed the fish’s tracks through the sea. Moses’ young companion said to him, ‘Do you remember when we took refuge at the rock? I forgot the fish, and none but Satan made me forget to mention it.’ Moses said, ‘That is what we were seeking.’ So they retraced their steps and found Khadir. The rest of their story was as Allah narrated.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7479, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ،‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ نَنْزِلُ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِخَيْفِ بَنِي كِنَانَةَ حَيْثُ تَقَاسَمُوا عَلَى الْكُفْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ الْمُحَصَّبَ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Yaman informed us: Shu‘ayb informed us, from al-Zuhri. Ahmad ibn Salih said: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Messenger of Allah, who said, “Tomorrow, if Allah wills, we will camp at Khayf Banu Kinana, where they swore an oath of disbelief.” He meant al-Muhassab.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7480, book 97, باب فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ حَاصَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَهْلَ الطَّائِفِ فَلَمْ يَفْتَحْهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّا قَافِلُونَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ نَقْفُلُ وَلَمْ نَفْتَحْ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاغْدُوا عَلَى الْقِتَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَغَدَوْا فَأَصَابَتْهُمْ جِرَاحَاتٌ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّا قَافِلُونَ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏، فَكَأَنَّ ذَلِكَ أَعْجَبَهُمْ فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
en_text: Abdullah ibn Muhammad narrated to us: Ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Amr, from Abu al-Abbas, from Abdullah ibn Umar, who said: The Prophet besieged the people of Taif but did not conquer it. He said, “We are departing, if Allah wills.” The Muslims said, “We are departing without having conquered it.” He said, “Then go out to fight tomorrow.” They went out the next morning and were wounded. The Prophet said, “We are departing tomorrow, if Allah wills.” This seemed to please them, and the Messenger of Allah smiled.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7481, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏وَلاَ تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ عِنْدَهُإِلاَّ لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ الأَمْرَ فِي السَّمَاءِ ضَرَبَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ بِأَجْنِحَتِهَا خُضْعَانًا لِقَوْلِهِ، كَأَنَّهُ سِلْسِلَةٌ عَلَى صَفْوَانٍ ـ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ صَفَوَانٍ ـ يَنْفُذُهُمْ ذَلِكَ، فَإِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ وَحَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، بِهَذَا‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ قَالَ عَمْرٌو سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ،‏.‏ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ قُلْتُ لِسُفْيَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِسُفْيَانَ إِنَّ إِنْسَانًا رَوَى عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ يَرْفَعُهُ أَنَّهُ قَرَأَ فُزِّعَ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ هَكَذَا قَرَأَ عَمْرٌو فَلاَ أَدْرِي سَمِعَهُ هَكَذَا أَمْ لاَ، قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَهْىَ قِرَاءَتُنَا‏.‏
en_text: Ali ibn Abdullah narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Amr, from Ikrimah, from Abu Hurayrah, who attributed it to the Prophet: “When Allah decrees a matter in heaven, the angels beat their wings in submission to His words, as though it were a chain dragged over smooth stone”—Ali said, “Another narrator said: over stone”—“and it passes through them. When terror is removed from their hearts, they say, ‘What did your Lord say?’ They say, ‘The truth; He is the Most High, the Great.’” Ali said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Amr, from Ikrimah, from Abu Hurayrah, with this report. Sufyan said: Amr said, “I heard Ikrimah narrate to us: Abu Hurayrah narrated to us.” Ali said: I asked Sufyan, “Did he say, ‘I heard Ikrimah say, I heard Abu Hurayrah’?” He said, “Yes.” I said to Sufyan, “Someone narrated from Amr, from Ikrimah, from Abu Hurayrah, attributing it to the Prophet, that he recited ‘fuzzi‘a’.” Sufyan said, “That is how Amr recited it; I do not know whether he heard it that way or not.” Sufyan said, “That is our recitation.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7482, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏وَلاَ تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ عِنْدَهُإِلاَّ لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِشَىْءٍ مَا أَذِنَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ صَاحِبٌ لَهُ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَجْهَرَ بِهِ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Bukayr narrated to us: al-Layth narrated to us, from Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab: Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman informed me, from Abu Hurayrah, who used to say that the Messenger of Allah said, “Allah has not listened to anything as He listens to a Prophet who recites the Quran aloud.” A companion of his said: He means that the Prophet recites it aloud.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7483, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏وَلاَ تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ عِنْدَهُإِلاَّ لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ يَا آدَمُ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ‏.‏ فَيُنَادَى بِصَوْتٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ تُخْرِجَ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِكَ بَعْثًا إِلَى النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Umar ibn Hafs ibn Ghiyath narrated to us: My father narrated to us: al-A‘mash narrated to us: Abu Salih narrated to us, from Abu Sa‘id al-Khudri, who said: The Prophet said, “Allah will say, ‘O Adam.’ He will reply, ‘At Your service and at Your pleasure.’ Then a voice will call out: Allah commands you to send forth a contingent from your descendants to the Fire.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7484, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏وَلاَ تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ عِنْدَهُإِلاَّ لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ مَا غِرْتُ عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ مَا غِرْتُ عَلَى خَدِيجَةَ، وَلَقَدْ أَمَرَهُ رَبُّهُ أَنْ يُبَشِّرَهَا بِبَيْتٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ‏.‏
en_text: Ubayd ibn Ismail narrated to us: Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from Aishah, who said: I was not jealous of any woman as I was jealous of Khadijah, for his Lord had commanded him to give her the glad tidings of a house in Paradise.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7485, book 97, باب كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ مَعَ جِبْرِيلَ وَنِدَاءِ اللَّهِ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ ـ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى إِذَا أَحَبَّ عَبْدًا نَادَى جِبْرِيلَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَبَّ فُلاَنًا فَأَحِبَّهُ فَيُحِبُّهُ جِبْرِيلُ، ثُمَّ يُنَادِي جِبْرِيلُ فِي السَّمَاءِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَبَّ فُلاَنًا فَأَحِبُّوهُ، فَيُحِبُّهُ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ وَيُوضَعُ لَهُ الْقَبُولُ فِي أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq narrated to me: Abd al-Samad narrated to us: Abd al-Rahman—Ibn Abdullah ibn Dinar—narrated to us, from his father, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “When Allah, Blessed and Exalted, loves a servant, He calls Gabriel: ‘Allah loves so-and-so, so love him.’ Gabriel loves him. Then Gabriel calls out in heaven, ‘Allah loves so-and-so, so love him,’ and the inhabitants of heaven love him, and acceptance of him is placed among the people of earth.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7486, book 97, باب كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ مَعَ جِبْرِيلَ وَنِدَاءِ اللَّهِ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَتَعَاقَبُونَ فِيكُمْ مَلاَئِكَةٌ بِاللَّيْلِ وَمَلاَئِكَةٌ بِالنَّهَارِ، وَيَجْتَمِعُونَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ وَصَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ، ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ الَّذِينَ بَاتُوا فِيكُمْ فَيَسْأَلُهُمْ وَهْوَ أَعْلَمُ كَيْفَ تَرَكْتُمْ عِبَادِي فَيَقُولُونَ تَرَكْنَاهُمْ وَهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ، وَأَتَيْنَاهُمْ وَهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa‘id narrated to us, from Malik, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A‘raj, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah said, “Angels take turns among you by night and by day, and they gather at the Asr and dawn prayers. Then those who spent the night among you ascend, and He asks them, though He knows best, ‘How did you leave My servants?’ They say, ‘We left them while they were praying, and we came to them while they were praying.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7487, book 97, باب كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ مَعَ جِبْرِيلَ وَنِدَاءِ اللَّهِ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ وَاصِلٍ، عَنِ الْمَعْرُورِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَانِي جِبْرِيلُ فَبَشَّرَنِي أَنَّهُ مَنْ مَاتَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ سَرَقَ وَإِنْ زَنَى قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ سَرَقَ وَإِنْ زَنَى ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us: Ghundar narrated to us: Shu‘bah narrated to us, from Wasıl, from al-Ma‘rur, who said: I heard Abu Dharr narrate from the Prophet, who said, “Gabriel came to me and gave me the glad tidings that whoever dies without associating anything with Allah will enter Paradise.” I said, “Even if he stole and committed adultery?” He said, “Even if he stole and committed adultery.”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7488, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏أَنْزَلَهُ بِعِلْمِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُيَشْهَدُونَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا فُلاَنُ إِذَا أَوَيْتَ إِلَى فِرَاشِكَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ‏.‏ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ مُتَّ فِي لَيْلَتِكَ مُتَّ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ، وَإِنْ أَصْبَحْتَ أَصَبْتَ أَجْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Musaddad narrated to us: Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us: Abu Ishaq al-Hamdani narrated to us, from al-Bara ibn Azib, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “O so-and-so, when you go to your bed, say: O Allah, I surrender myself to You, turn my face to You, entrust my affair to You, and rely upon You, in hope and fear of You. There is no refuge or escape from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You sent down and in Your Prophet whom You sent.” If you die that night, you will die upon the natural way; and if you wake in the morning, you will have attained reward.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7489, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏أَنْزَلَهُ بِعِلْمِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُيَشْهَدُونَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ الأَحْزَابِ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ وَزَلْزِلْ بِهِمْ ‏"‏‏.‏ زَادَ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa‘id narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ismail ibn Abi Khalid, from Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa, who said: On the Day of the Confederates, the Messenger of Allah said, “O Allah, Revealer of the Book, swift in reckoning, defeat the confederates and shake them.” Al-Humaydi added: Sufyan narrated to us: Ibn Abi Khalid narrated to us: I heard Abdullah say: I heard the Prophet.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7490, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏أَنْزَلَهُ بِعِلْمِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُيَشْهَدُونَ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ ‏[quran sura="17" aya_start="110" aya_end="110"]{‏وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}‏ قَالَ أُنْزِلَتْ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُتَوَارٍ بِمَكَّةَ، فَكَانَ إِذَا رَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ سَمِعَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ فَسَبُّوا الْقُرْآنَ وَمَنْ أَنْزَلَهُ وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِهِ‏.‏ وَقَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏[quran sura="17" aya_start="110" aya_end="110"]{‏وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا‏}‏ لاَ تَجْهَرْ بِصَلاَتِكَ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ، وَلاَ تُخَافِتْ بِهَا عَنْ أَصْحَابِكَ فَلاَ تُسْمِعُهُمْ ‏[quran sura="17" aya_start="110" aya_end="110"]{‏وَابْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ سَبِيلاً‏}‏ أَسْمِعْهُمْ وَلاَ تَجْهَرْ حَتَّى يَأْخُذُوا عَنْكَ الْقُرْآنَ‏.‏
en_text: Musaddad narrated to us, from Hushaym, from Abu Bishr, from Sa‘id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, regarding “Do not recite your prayer aloud, nor recite it silently” Quran 17:110. He said: It was revealed while the Messenger of Allah was concealed in Mecca. When he raised his voice, the polytheists heard him and reviled the Quran, the One who sent it down, and the one who brought it. Allah Most High said, “Do not recite your prayer aloud, nor recite it silently”: do not recite it aloud so the polytheists hear, and do not recite it so quietly that your companions cannot hear you. “Seek a way between that” Quran 17:110: let them hear you, but do not recite so loudly that they take the Quran from you.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7491, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى يُؤْذِينِي ابْنُ آدَمَ، يَسُبُّ الدَّهْرَ وَأَنَا الدَّهْرُ، بِيَدِي الأَمْرُ، أُقَلِّبُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Al-Humaydi narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us: al-Zuhri narrated to us, from Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyab, from Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Prophet said, “Allah Most High says, ‘The son of Adam offends Me: he curses time, while I am Time. The matter is in My hand; I turn night and day.’”

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 7492, book 97, باب قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏ {‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ الصَّوْمُ لِي وَأَنَا أَجْزِي بِهِ يَدَعُ شَهْوَتَهُ وَأَكْلَهُ وَشُرْبَهُ مِنْ أَجْلِي، وَالصَّوْمُ جُنَّةٌ، وَلِلصَّائِمِ فَرْحَتَانِ فَرْحَةٌ حِينَ يُفْطِرُ وَفَرْحَةٌ حِينَ يَلْقَى رَبَّهُ، وَلَخَلُوفُ فَمِ الصَّائِمِ أَطْيَبُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abu Nu‘aym narrated to us: al-A‘mash narrated to us, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, who said: “Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says, ‘Fasting is for Me, and I reward it. He gives up his desire, food, and drink for My sake. Fasting is a shield. The fasting person has two joys: joy when he breaks his fast and joy when he meets his Lord. The smell from the mouth of a fasting person is more pleasant to Allah than the fragrance of musk.’”
